Okay, so in terms of shadowing at the beginning, it was motors, yes, but it wasn't just cells and service. It's cells after cells and operations for power. It was the steel fabrication, it was the store, it was I believe the engineering or design department, it was maintenance. Then there was the general medical which is actually referred to as afro-medical. Then it's not mechanical transport, it was mechanical transport as in transport for the whole group. That's for whether it's delivering stuff, whether it's staff travel, whether it is individuals coming from abroad that need to be picked up from the airport things like that. I'm not sure how many people have been there. 

One assumption you've made is that the stuff that came from the PFI tracker was used exactly to do the CRM plan v2. Between v1 and v2, we had: - V1 - we had the Nateg soft project and we began to look into the inventory tool - PFI tracking - we had multiple discussions with sales about the PFI tracking - We started to notice some of the other issues that we were having - We were introduced to the AI agency who then did the iterative process to come up with a good proposal and pricing structure - The CRM plan v2 or the CX blueprint was then done

One thing I will say, although we were only one point when we had 3 out of the 10 reps logging consistently. This wasn't entirely just because it was their fault - there was one rep that didn't have a working laptop, one didn't have internet at home, and there were a bunch of other things. 

The Operations Command Centre app is a concept that we're still building and it began late May of 2025, not January of 2025. 

For the Mikano website feedback, you could say that I am a QA tester of sorts, not a reviewer. 

At the moment, we are not doing the tracking PFI system. That reminds me of a collaborative project which was between myself and the product and business intelligence team. This was moving away from the PFI tracking to a system that required you to create a PFI for a customer. When that customer decides that they want to pay, that PFI must be requested to be converted into a sales invoice as opposed to two separate documents (one being the PFI and one being the sales invoice). This was to at least link the cells in place to the PFI, but of course we still have the issue of linking the PFI at the lead stage and also linking past the sell stage and having like accounts so that now we have proper tracking from awareness to after sales.
